import sys, json, time, resource, subprocess, os, pathlib

                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
wall=time.monotonic()-start
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
